name: claude-workflow-kit
description: nil-park's personal Claude Code workflow skills, managed via GitOps.

plugins.name: project-skills-bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs a set of shared working conventions into the project. Together they govern how a change is written, reviewed, documented, and delivered, where its working files live, and how idiomatic its Korean prose reads. Each convention is a separate bootstrap skill, so a project can adopt only the ones it needs. The skill files are written under .agents/skills/ and symlinked from .claude/skills/, so the repository carries them. A multi-session orchestration skill, which works only in Claude Code, is written directly under .claude/skills/ instead. The Korean-prose convention also installs a Stop hook that flags English-calqued Korean in files the turn just edited, registering it in the project's settings.json.

plugins.name: user-tools-bootstrap
plugins.description: Installs personal tools that live outside any project. The statusline skill builds the Go status line binary into ~/.claude/bin with go install and points statusLine in the user settings at it. Invoking the skill again rebuilds the binary from the latest main.
